title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 084 ]

blocks.text: People tend to stick to their first impressions, even if they are wrong. Suppose you mention the name of your new neighbor to a friend. “Oh, I know him,” your friend replies. “He seems nice at first, but it’s all an act.” Perhaps this evaluation is groundless. The neighbor may have changed since your friend knew him, or perhaps your friend’s judgment is simply unfair. Whether the judgment is accurate or not, once you accept it, it will probably influence the way you respond to the neighbor. Even if this neighbor were a saint, you would be likely to interpret his behavior in ways that fit your expectation.

readingSentences.english: People tend to stick to their first impressions, even if they are wrong.
readingSentences.korean: 사람들은 첫인상이 잘못된 것일지라도 그것을 고수하는 경향이 있다.

readingSentences.english: Suppose you mention the name of your new neighbor to a friend.
readingSentences.korean: 새로 이사 온 이웃의 이름을 친구에게 말했다고 가정해 보자.

readingSentences.english: “Oh, I know him,” your friend replies.
readingSentences.korean: “오, 난 그를 알아,”라고 당신의 친구가 대답한다.

readingSentences.english: “He seems nice at first, but it’s all an act.”
readingSentences.korean: “그 사람은 처음엔 좋은 사람처럼 보이지만, 다 연기야.”
어쩌면 이 평가는 근거가 없을 수도 있다.

readingSentences.english: The neighbor may have changed since your friend knew him, or perhaps your friend’s judgment is simply unfair.
readingSentences.korean: 그 이웃 사람은 당신의 친구가 그를 알고 난 이후로 바뀌었을 수도 있고, 혹은 당신 친구의 판단이 그저 불공정한 것일 수도 있다.

readingSentences.english: Whether the judgment is accurate or not, once you accept it, it will probably influence the way you respond to the neighbor.
readingSentences.korean: 그 판단이 정확하건 그렇지 않건, 일단 당신이 그것을 받아들이면, 그것은 당신이 그 이웃에 대해 반응하는 방식에 영향을 줄 것이다.

readingSentences.english: Even if this neighbor were a saint, you would be likely to interpret his behavior in ways that fit your expectation.
readingSentences.korean: 비록 이 이웃이 성자일지라도, 당신은 당신의 예상에 맞는 방식으로 그의 행동을 해석할 가능성이 높다.
